DOM Ready
The DOM Ready event will run your rule when the objects on the page physically exist, but NOT necessarily when all of your content has loaded. 
For instance, when you see the page and the images on the page have not yet loaded – your DOM is ready, but the window has not yet finished 
loading.

Library Loaded (Page Top)
